resource: Items reachable through one creature's corpse (the corpse ItemInstance and its direct Container entries)
allocation_impact: Follows from one corpse item, depth 1 and at most 16 entries (the corpse item itself plus its 16 entries); mirrors GAMEITEM01-REACHABLE-ITEMS.
boundary_tests: max=17: a fully looted-into corpse (1 corpse item + 16 entries) is read in full
max+1=18: an 18th reachable item (a 17th entry) is refused
